lead.event: Government issues Perpres 27/2026 on ride-hailing delivery tariffs
lead.headline: Government issues Perpres 27/2026 setting delivery platform fee cut at 8% maximum
lead.blurb: The regulation extends legal protection to app-based transport, goods delivery and food orders, including partnerships with drivers, culinary merchants and SME partners. Transportation Minister Dudy Purwagandhi said the maximum platform fee cut is 8%, also set out in a ministry decree. Communications Deputy Minister Nezar Patria said his ministry can set goods and food delivery tariffs and require transparent pricing. Ministries must complete implementing rules before 31 December.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Fortune Indonesia completes rights issue exercise
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: FORU completes rights exercise with 169.38 billion rights taken up
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Fortune Indonesia recorded 169.38 billion rights exercised from 25 September to 6 October, while 45.72 billion went unexercised. Controlling shareholder IMR Asia Holding plans to exercise about 165.22 billion rights, partly by depositing a 49% stake in Borneo Prima valued at about Rp20.82 trillion. Non-participating shareholders face dilution of up to 99.78%.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Mitra Komunikasi Nusantara completes private placement and changes its name
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MKNT completes Rp1.02 trillion placement as shareholders approve name change
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Mitra Komunikasi Nusantara issued 1.02 trillion shares at Rp1 each, including debt conversions of Rp668 billion to Headwell Bintang Energi Hijau and Rp154.92 billion to Mantra Capital Persada. Shareholders approved the name Remitra Global International on 14 September, and issued shares rose from 5.5 billion to 1.03 trillion.

deals_control.event: Haji Isam’s BYAN acquisition and Bank Mandiri-backed share pledges
deals_control.headline: BYAN logs Rp26.1tn crossing for 30.252% deal as affiliates pledge Rp80.33tn in shares
deals_control.blurb: Jhonlin Baratama plans to buy 10.084 billion shares, or about 30.252%, from Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low at Rp2,588 each. Haji Isam affiliates pledged PGUN and JARR stakes to Bank Mandiri as collateral valued at Rp80.33 trillion. IDX was reviewing the amended agreement as of 8 October.

deals_control.event: Danantara and Energi Mega Persada invest in HighPeak Energy
deals_control.headline: ENRG agrees to invest US$200 million as Danantara announces US$250 million for HighPeak
deals_control.blurb: Energi Mega Persada agreed to invest through newly issued convertible preferred shares that can convert into HighPeak common shares. Danantara separately announced a preferred-share investment to be issued in stages, and ENRG described its agreement as business cooperation with Danantara.

deals_control.event: Ultrajaya plans rights issue to acquire Frisian Flag Indonesia
deals_control.headline: ULTJ plans rights issue to acquire 100% of Frisian Flag Indonesia
deals_control.blurb: Ultrajaya plans to use part of the proceeds to acquire all of Frisian Flag Indonesia’s shares, contributed as non-cash capital. FrieslandCampina International Holding BV would become Ultrajaya’s controlling shareholder and make a mandatory tender offer for the remaining public shares.

deals_control.event: Adhi Karya plans toll-road stake sale and rights-issue fund reallocation
deals_control.headline: ADHI plans Rp1.77 trillion JMJ stake sale and rights-fund reallocation
deals_control.blurb: Adhi Karya signed a conditional deal to sell 47.18% of JMJ to Sarana Multi Infrastruktur for Rp1.77 trillion, targeting completion by 30 November subject to approvals. It proposes redirecting Rp378.69 billion in remaining rights-issue proceeds to working capital. Shareholders will consider both proposals at an extraordinary meeting on 13 November.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX and KSEI disclose BSWD shareholding concentration amid suspension
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX and KSEI disclose 99.95% BSWD concentration amid suspension
market_structure_policy.blurb: Other investors held about 0.05% as of 2 October. Trading in the Regular and Cash Markets has been suspended since 5 October, and IDX and KSEI said the disclosure did not indicate a rules violation. Bank of India Indonesia said it expected to complete all conditions for lifting the suspension on 8 October.

market_structure_policy.event: Danantara targets state-owned construction company mergers by November
market_structure_policy.headline: Danantara targets two SOE construction mergers by November, including ADHI and PTPP
market_structure_policy.blurb: The pairings are Adhi Karya with PP and Nindya Karya with Brantas Abipraya, while the surviving entity in each deal remains under review. Danantara plans to assess assets after consolidation and sell non-core holdings to reduce debt, targeting completion by the end of November.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX suspends four state-owned construction stocks
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX keeps ADHI, WIKA, WSKT and PTPP suspended through 8 October
market_structure_policy.blurb: The suspensions remain in force through trading on 8 October. PP was the latest halted, from 5 October, after deferring interest payments on bonds and sukuk due 2 October, which IDX said indicated going-concern problems.

other.event: Mitrabahtera Segara Sejati denies corporate action plans amid share surge
other.headline: MBSS denies corporate action plans as shares rise 54.64%
other.blurb: Mitrabahtera Segara Sejati said it knew of no material information behind the rally and had no plans in the next three months that would affect its listing. Control passed to Andy Wibowo in August, when his investment vehicle Wibowo Group Capital bought about 1.44 billion shares from Galley Adhika Arnawama for about Rp4.2 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI Danareksa raises Alamtri Resources’ target price
earnings_guidance.headline: BRI Danareksa raises ADRO target price to Rp3,300
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI Danareksa maintained its buy recommendation, citing coking coal price assumptions of US$230 per ton for 2026, US$220 for 2027 and US$200 for 2028, up from US$170 previously. It raised earnings estimates by 4.3% for 2026, 2.6% for 2027 and 2.9% for 2028.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI Danareksa raises Adaro Minerals’ target price
earnings_guidance.headline: BRI Danareksa raises ADMR target price to Rp3,300
earnings_guidance.blurb: The broker maintained its buy recommendation and raised coking coal assumptions for 2026–28 to US$230, US$220 and US$200 a ton, citing supply disruptions in China and Mongolia. Adaro Minerals’ 2026 sales estimate remains 6 million tons, with third-quarter sales expected at 500,000–700,000 tons and a catch-up anticipated in the fourth quarter as volumes are contracted.

earnings_guidance.event: Analysts set new GoTo price target after IDX floor-price change
earnings_guidance.headline: Analysts set GOTO’s 12-month target at Rp68 after IDX price-floor change
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bloomberg's consensus implies a potential 137% 12-month return from GoTo's latest Rp29 price. Of 29 analysts, 79.3% recommend buy, 17.2% hold and 3.4% sell. Citi says the decline after the IDX removed the minimum share price floor to Rp1 is largely technical, citing an unrealized Rp3.5 trillion buyback as support.

earnings_guidance.event: Mandiri Herindo Adoperkasa reports H1 2026 profit surge
earnings_guidance.headline: MAHA reports 1,386% H1 2026 net profit surge
earnings_guidance.blurb: Mandiri Herindo's net profit was Rp139.5 billion versus Rp9.4 billion, while revenue rose 34.1% to Rp1.65 trillion. The profit comparison reflects a base effect from unrealized share-investment losses in H1 2025. A Bayan Group hauling backlog covers 368 million tons and is valued at Rp23.9 trillion through 2034.
